    top = diff.sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
    print(f"\n=== Dimension: {dim} ===")
    print(f"Number of unique values: {pivot.shape[0]}")
    print("Top increases on 2025-10-20 (anomaly day value - mean of other days):")
    for name, d in top.items():
        print(f"  {name}: anomaly_day={anom_val[name]:.2f}, other_mean={other_mean[name]:.2f}, diff={d:.2f}")
